It follows the wealthy boy Cedric, who lives with his parents in the United States, but when his father dies due to illness, he travels to England with his mother to his wealthy grandfather’s castle.

A Jordanian educational series for children, which includes segments on various topics, presented in an interesting and sometimes comical way. Its segments include Farhan's Kitchen, the Adventures of Abu Al-Horof, the Secret Team, and Zaid and Amr.

Madness and greed fuel a compelling game between three self-centered people. A man who never retreats, seeking power and fortune; a corrupt, cold-hearted lady seeking control; and an opportunistic businessman who manipulates everyone to maintain his position through shady dealings. The conflict between desire and betrayal shows power when ambition becomes insane.
A drama/romance which takes place in separate episodes that contain different stories about relationships that try to break the barriers that prevent them from continuing.

Father Time decides to turn five executives into baby animals, in an attempt to fix all the environmental disasters that have occurred, but the difficulty lies in turning them back into humans, which requires searching for gemstones that can help them return to the human world.

Monkey D. Luffy ate a Devil Fruit when he was young that granted him rubber attributes. At the age of 17, he decides to go on a journey to sail the seas in search of the legendary treasure One Piece that Gol D. Roger mentioned before his execution. He is accompanied by a team of 8 people. What does fate have in store for them?
